tableau_de_bord.execution_recouvrement: Overall consumption adds the lines of the approved version: an expense covered by two overlapping lines counts twice there (see availability per line)
tableau_de_bord.methode_consolidation: Latest “{type_taux}” rate on {jour}, in {reference}; each (project, currency) amount converted then rounded to the reference currency before addition
tableau_de_bord.taux_manquant: Indicator not consolidated: no “{type_taux}” rate on {jour} for {devises}
tableau_de_bord.execution_etat_courant: Budget execution (current budget, committed, spent) is as of today, not as of the requested date; the other indicators are as of the requested date
tableau_de_bord.reference_non_parametree: Indicator not consolidated: no reference currency is set on {jour} (neither for the organisation nor for the projects concerned). Set it in the currency settings or choose one.
tableau_de_bord.type_taux_non_parametre: Indicator not consolidated: no rate type is set on {jour} (neither for the organisation nor for the projects concerned). Set it in the currency settings or choose one.
tableau_de_bord.references_differentes: Indicator not consolidated: the projects concerned set different reference currencies ({detail}). Choose a reference currency for this total.
tableau_de_bord.type_taux_differents: Indicator not consolidated: the projects concerned set different rate types ({detail}). Choose a rate type for this total.
tableau_de_bord.methode_consolidation_cr: Latest “{type_taux}” rate on {jour}, expressed in {tenue} (book currency); each (project, currency) amount converted into {reference} by cross rate through {tenue}, then rounded to the reference currency before addition
